summary:
Phase 13 Comprehensive Platform Audit, Architecture & Integration Register.
Evaluates repository status, routing structure, authentication & RBAC extensions, database entities, GitHub Actions workflow, local Windows drive sync controller integration, and survivor safeguarding invariants.
Details the technical strategy for M13.01 through M13.10 and the 35 automated acceptance tests (TEST-P13-01 to TEST-P13-35).
